LanguageData.TM_CommanderSupplyTrial: Coordinated deliveries {0}/12. Use Work Crew on an ally who completes a real haul before the order expires.
LanguageData.TM_CommanderEvacTrial: Distinct allies led out of danger {0}/8, or assigned repairs completed {1}/16. Issue Move Out near a hostile or use Work Crew on an ally repairing a damaged building. Work Crew must be assigned while the ally repairs a colony building damaged by a hostile or an uncontrolled fire.
LanguageData.TM_CommanderServiceTrial: Service days {0}/10 or successful emergency work orders {1}/10. Complete real crew jobs. Warrior level {2}/30.
LanguageData.TM_CommanderOperationUnavailable: Requires an ascended command operation, 60% available stamina and a finished cooldown.
LanguageData.TM_CommanderDoctrineSupply: Provisioner supplies the native support aura. Work Crew bonuses apply only to the assigned job.
LanguageData.TM_CommanderDoctrineSignals: Clear Signals adds 2/4/6/8/10 percentage points to the chance of accepting an order, capped at 95%.
